signals.usability_note: Clear frontal view of a single-story ranch home; a large street tree trunk partially obscures the right side of the house.

professional_landscaping.evidence: Neatly rounded shrubs, mulched beds, a stone-ringed tree bed, and a Japanese maple show a well-kept yard, but there is no crew-level evidence and it is consistent with homeowner maintenance.

signals.notes: Well-maintained ranch with light green siding, dark shutters, and an attached garage on the right; there is heavy mature tree canopy over the lot, and a vehicle visible at the far left edge appears to belong to the neighboring property.
